sections.section_title: SPI CRC polynomial register (SPI_CRCPR) (not used in I2S
sections.text_helper: Section 25.5.5 "SPI CRC polynomial register (SPI_CRCPR) (not used in I2S" in chapter 25 (Serial peripheral interface (SPI)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 746.
sections.section_content:
mode)
Address offset: 0x10
Reset value: 0x0007
Bits 15:0 CRCPOLY[15:0]: CRC polynomial register
This register contains the polynomial for the CRC calculation.
The CRC polynomial (0007h) is the reset value of this register. Another polynomial can be
configured as required.
Note: These bits are not used for the I2S mode.
